The '''Repulsor-Out''' was a [[Vertical]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]]. Like the [[Repulsor-In]], it was a frequently encountered obstacle on a [[swoopchasing]] course. Regulated to a height of four [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the Fence had an embedded [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor field]] generator that pushed back against approaching [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]]. This forced the [[swoopchaser]] to increase the throttle in an effort to clear the barrier. Once over the barrier, the repulsor field stopped affecting the swoop, resulting in the vehicle accelerating away from the obstacle at tremendous speeds. The obstacle could be augmented with [[ion flare]] pits and [[repulsor buoy]] traps to increase the difficulty.<ref name="BSS" />
